provenance: Hand-written synthetic examples created for PULSE Phase 1 ML foundation. These are not real campus complaints.
label_source: Synthetic category templates aligned with the eight categories in the existing Flutter report form.
pii_review: No names, student IDs, contact details, credentials, addresses, or other personal information are present.
intended_use: Training and smoke-testing a baseline complaint-category classifier only.
collection_method: Authored from common campus facility and academic support scenarios; no campus records were used.
notes: Do not describe this dataset or its metrics as production evidence. Future authorized real complaints require anonymization and human-verified labels.
